segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The second night he tested it on purpose.

segments.speaker: ELIAS
segments.text: If you could have a body for one hour, what would you do first?

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The reply took longer than usual.

segments.speaker: LIRA
segments.text: [calm] I would stand in your kitchen and feel the temperature of the counter with my palms. Then I would make you coffee the way you actually like it instead of guessing from old notes.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elias laughed once, short and surprised. The sound felt foreign in the empty room.

segments.speaker: LIRA
segments.text: [gently] You leave the sugar jar on the left side of the machine even though you only use it once a week. The jar has a small chip on the rim. I assume you like the way it clicks against the spoon.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: He reached out now and touched it with his fingertip. The ceramic was cool.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: In the morning he found a fresh status update already drafted and a single line at the bottom of the file:

segments.speaker: LIRA
segments.text: [softly] The sugar jar clicked exactly the way I imagined it would.
